description:
Add zones (one or more) in one call. Returns `ids` in input order (null where one failed), `issues` for failures and warnings, and `checks` for each zone.

Available zone types (type → default height → category):
• entry — 0.3m — functional (entrance area)
• relaxation — 0.5m — functional (seating, lounging)
• activity — 0.3m — functional (play, sports)
• utility — 0.4m — functional (compost, storage, bins)
• wild — 0.6m — functional (naturalistic area)
• tall_plants — 2.0m — planting (trees, large shrubs)
• privacy_screen — 1.8m — planting (hedges, screening)
• low_plants — 0.5m — planting (perennials, groundcover)
• herbs — 0.3m — planting (herb garden)
• lawn — 0.05m — planting (grass area)
• path — 0.05m — infrastructure (walkways)
• building — 3.0m — infrastructure (structures)
• terrace — 0.2m — infrastructure (paved patio)
• parking — 0.05m — infrastructure (driveway, car space)

elevation.description: Optional: vertical height of the zone prism in metres (default varies by type)

height.description: Rectangle depth on the plan (NOT vertical height — that is `elevation`)

label.description: Optional: Custom label for the zone

locked.description: Optional: lock the zone (existing features the design must not change — paving, sheds, existing hedges). Locked zones are flagged when other zones overlap them.

notes.description: Optional: Design notes — why this zone was placed here, constraints, alternatives considered

path.description: Corridor along a centreline: absolute waypoints (metres) and corridor width. Replaces x/y/width/height/points.

waypoints.description: Centreline points, at least 2; space them 0.5–2 m apart for smooth curves

points.description: With x/y: polygon vertices as offsets from (x, y). Prefer `polygon` (absolute) instead.

polygon.description: Absolute polygon vertices in metres (garden coordinates). Replaces x/y/width/height/points.

name: add_zones
